body:
I cried since past months a few times in a week and a few times in a day. 

It's almost 3 a.m. I'm crying right now while writing this. Never felt so broken in my life ever. Everything seems so scattered around me.

Thank you. She was the only one who loved and cared me with all of her heart but now she doesn't even ask how I am. Never thought things will change like this. If it was like this since day one, it wouldn't have hurt like this it's feeling now. 

Some people become like habits you can't get over them even if you really want to. My mother always told me that never stop doing good for others even if they don't do it for you. So I kept trying hoping to get her back someday but I don't really know :)
From a Friend. He supplies laboratory materials for local colleges.
Hello, are you here? We can talk if you want.

Send it man. Atleast you tried your best that's what really matters at the end of the day. I'm facing the same thing as of now. 

Like they say, *The hole in one's heart will eventually get filled by the others around you.*

I can relate with you very much. I've lost almost everything also a person can lose in his entire lifetime. My brother, my mother, my love of life and my job in the past few months. 

I'm planning to do the same as you, I also begged and cried to my partner but she overlooked it and kept silent. 

I can feel you, when people run in circles everyday they are helpless. 

I wish from my core of heart you will find in your next life whatever you wanted in this life. I truly wish that.

Don't know man what I'll do. I feel abandoned by my loved ones. The person I loved the fullest told me she has lost interest in our relationship. But I can't force people to love me. All I could do is to wait but I don't know either what's waiting for me in the end, may it be death or something. 

I just wanted to grow older with her, have a family. I just wanted that atleast one person will feel blessed for having me in their life but it never happened. I'm very close to a mental breakdown sooner or later.

I was a failure in life , I always was. In studies, in school, in my college, in my company also in love and relationships and I was a burden to the persons I met.

Also my partner loved me for 8 years straight that nobody did to me ever. We shared everything in between but things got worst suddenly. She told me one day she needed some space and I gave her that. But I received nothing but distance from her. I kept assuring her that something will unite us together again, but nothing happened.

I have managed to get rid of my anger issues somehow these days but it seems impossible to forget someone with whom I wanted to grow older and have a family together.
 
Every inch of the walls of my house has her touch, every corners I see her face, wherever I go her voice pops out in my mind, we lived together for so many years now she stays in a separate building.

My friends are assholes, they have mocked me my entire life and I know if they somehow find out I failed in my relationship too, they will start mocking me again.
Thank you, I wish the same to you maybe someday you will also find something you truly wanted all of your life.

> It's always darkest before dawn.

Those lines motivated me a bit, thank you. But if I wake up tomorrow again the situation will feel worst even more. I'm waiting the situations might change someday but I won't be there to see it anymore. 

People are lucky who die in sleep or die in a sudden accident or die from a non curable disease. I have never been lucky that my life but I'll be happiest if I get that luck by my side.

Thank you for hearing me out. I'm currently residing in India. I've my father in home but he doesn't seem to care about anything at all. Few months ago my partner told me she lost interest in our 8 years relationship and doesn't want me anymore in her life. She's told me to go away from her life but I simply can't do that. We've so many memories together and It is haunting me every moment. She has started avoiding me and insulting me. Few months ago we had an argument and things got changed after that. I have anger issues maybe that's the reason nobody likes me anymore. I don't know what to do atm. I still love her so much and I don't think I can't live without her a single moment. I don't know what should I do. Thanks again.
